name: Traversal
what: AI SRE (site reliability engineering) platform that does alert triage, root-cause analysis, production support and self-healing using a causal 'Production World Model'. Customers cited on its site include Nubank, Harvey, PepsiCo, DigitalOcean, Cloudways and Amex.
investors: Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Battery Ventures, Amex Ventures
source_note: Traversal: $120M Series B at ~$1B valuation (also stated on traversal.com: 'raised a $120M Series B at a $1B valuation')
